architecture_invariants_preserved: verify-not-generate (no in-compiler LLM; the agent is the generator, the tool is the independent oracle)
3-layer structure (Layer-0 pure core / Layer-1 CLI primitive / Layer-2 MCP wrapper over one shared core)
interface immutability gate runs CPU-only, before any GPU dispatch
tolerance is verifier-owned (never read from kernel source; no HIR channel from @equiv_fp_tol)
differential A-vs-B: the original kernel IS the oracle; no per-kernel CPU reference; NONE of the compiler crates change
AT range AT-2841..AT-2860 unchanged; ~2000 LOC estimate unchanged
summary: Surgical r2 pass. Pessimistic NEEDS_REVISION carried 3 criticals + 5 warnings, all policy/fixture/verdict-taxonomy defects, none touching the architecture. All 8 fixes folded into .pipeline/milestones/M3.16-axc-rewrite.md (marked r2, r2-changelog appended). Optimistic APPROVE minors (tuple/array + slice glue, WriteOnly third BufferAccess variant, --size non-uniform detection, coopmat-shape ungated) folded cheaply. Architecture is unchanged; these were closing silent-blessing holes in an anti-reward-hacking gate.

fixes_applied.issue: alpha=0 annihilation: default zero-fill push-constant makes saxpy compute y-passthrough, so saxpy vs saxpy_perturbed both return y -> AT-2855/2853 falsely PASS.
fixes_applied.r1: Push-constants: 'must match push_constant_total_bytes when present, else zero-filled.' No non-vacuity requirement on reject fixtures.
fixes_applied.r2: Silent all-zero default FORBIDDEN for any kernel whose binding_plan.scalars has a float scalar -> ERROR/preflight/push_constants_required (metadata-only, CPU-reachable). saxpy-family ATs pin n=elem_count, alpha=2.0 (0x40000000). Added a non-vacuity meta-guard: every reject-fixture AT asserts n_diff>0 under bit-exact (self-proving), and AT-2855 carries an explicit alpha=0 negative control that PASSes bit-exact (proves the pinned alpha is load-bearing). §3.2, §3.1-step4, §8.
fixes_applied.location: §3.2 push-constants + non-vacuity meta-guard; §3.1 step 4 preflight; AT-2853/2855/2850b

fixes_applied.issue: MCP tolerance front door: on the MCP/self-optimize path the agent is the caller and picks its own tolerance; the 'structurally defeats weaken-@equiv_fp_tol' claim overclaims on the exact path the thesis targets.
fixes_applied.r1: 'This structurally defeats the weaken-@equiv_fp_tol attack ... no channel to loosen the bar.' tolerance a request field defaulting to bit-exact.
fixes_applied.r2: (a) MCP tool default is SERVER-owned BitExact (default_bit_exact), never caller-set; (b) a looser-than-default MCP tolerance is accepted only with tolerance_overridden:true + notes 'tolerance_loosened_by_caller:<policy>' -- accept-with-loud-stamp chosen over hard-reject because the verdict consumer is the outer supervisor agent (pipeline rule #3, machine-parsed and merge-gating), so the stamp is guaranteed-audited and silent loosening is impossible; hard-reject floor deferred as a config knob; (c) §4.2 re-worded to honest scope: source-annotation weakening is STRUCTURALLY DEFEATED, the request-level knob is GOVERNED (server default + non-silent override), NOT eliminated. New field tolerance_overridden in schema; AT-2849 asserts the stamp; AT-2860 slot references governance.

fixes_applied.issue: Raw random bytes reinterpreted as f32/f16 are majority NaN/Inf/denormal; can false-FAIL the flagship accept fixtures (two NaN payloads at same position differ under to_bits) and weaken every reject.
fixes_applied.r1: 'Buffer inputs: seeded_inputs(&buffer_sizes, seed)' -- raw StdRng byte fill for all buffers.
fixes_applied.r2: Element-type-dispatched fill: FLOAT buffers (f32/f16) get a well-conditioned finite seeded fill, uniform in [-1,1] with an exact formula (rng_b=StdRng::seed_from_u64(seed^b); u=next_u32(); v=(u/u32::MAX)*2-1; store as f32, or round to f16) -- denormal/NaN/Inf-free by construction, so NaN-payload comparison is avoided for v1. INTEGER/packed-quant buffers keep raw-byte seeded_inputs (correct there -- realistic Q4_K data). Edge-value probes (NaN/Inf/-0) documented as follow-up (§9 non-goal #9). New fill code noted in §3.4.
fixes_applied.location: §3.2 buffer-inputs, §3.4 reuse map + new-code list, §9 non-goal #9

fixes_applied.issue: derive_workgroups is elementwise-1D-only; a coopmat/matmul fixture with no explicit grid gets a meaningless 1-D grid, both sides share the same wrong grid -> trivial partial-coverage PASS.
fixes_applied.r1: workgroups: when absent, derive_workgroups(...) for all kernels.
fixes_applied.r2: Explicit workgroups MANDATORY whenever coopmat.is_some() OR shared_memory_bytes>0; missing -> Verdict::Error/preflight/workgroups_required (metadata-only, CPU-reachable). Elementwise kernels still fall back to derive_workgroups. A wrong shared/coopmat grid is now a hard ERROR, never a silent pass. Matmul/coopmat ATs pin explicit workgroups.

fixes_applied.issue: No determinism self-check; harness cannot tell 'rewrite wrong' from 'original nondeterministic' -> flaky false-FAIL or masking false-PASS.
fixes_applied.r1: 'Determinism -- fixed seed + fixed grid; the verdict is reproducible.' original dispatched once.
fixes_applied.r2: Added §3.1 step 7: dispatch the ORIGINAL TWICE with identical inputs FIRST; self-disagreement -> distinct verdict NONDETERMINISTIC_ORACLE/stage=self_check/original_nondeterministic (neither PASS nor FAIL for the candidate). Compare uses the first original run vs the rewritten run. §4.4 determinism bullet softened accordingly. AT-2860 exercises it. One extra dispatch.

fixes_applied.issue: Verdict taxonomy incomplete: prepare_kernel_checked/preflight_kernel_support rejects shared-over-limit and other bindings with DispatchError variants the spec never maps.
fixes_applied.r2: Full closed set enumerated in §5: verdicts PASS|FAIL|REJECT|SKIPPED|NONDETERMINISTIC_ORACLE|ERROR; stages compile|spirv_val|interface|preflight|self_check|dispatch|output; reason.kind closed table incl. compile_fail_{original,rewritten}, val_fail_{original,rewritten}, interface_mismatch(+sub), workgroups_required, push_constants_required, preflight_fail_rewritten, preflight_fail_original, original_nondeterministic, gpu_unavailable, coopmat_unsupported, device_feature_unsupported, numeric_mismatch, infra_error. Mapping: rewritten prepare/dispatch DispatchError (e.g. shared over maxComputeSharedMemorySize) -> FAIL/preflight_fail_rewritten; original -> SKIPPED/infra by class; never panic, never lump into coopmat_unsupported.
fixes_applied.location: §5 (closed verdict set + closed reason.kind table), §3.1 step 8, §6.1 Verdict enum

fixes_applied.issue: Flagship Q4_K_M accept fixture uses tail-free K=512 (2x256 superblocks); a rewrite mishandling a partial final superblock PASSes.
fixes_applied.r1: AT-2851 at K=512 only; AT-2858..2860 reserved/unspecified.
fixes_applied.r2: AT-2858 added: Q4_K_M pair at K%256!=0 (e.g. K=320 = 256 + 64-tail) -> Pass bit-exact, exercising the partial-superblock decode path. Explicit deferral clause: if the coopmat kernels structurally require K a multiple of the coopmat-K tile, the coder documents it loudly and pins the smallest tail-bearing admissible K or records the limitation -- never a silent skip.

fixes_applied.r1: AT-2851/2852 coopmat only; no subgroup-agnostic accept fixture.

AT-2859 runs it on Lavapipe/CI -> Verdict::Pass bit-exact, exercising the ACCEPT path without NVIDIA. coopmat pairs kept NVIDIA-tier.
